purpose: Teach: 何気ない/あかね/たぐい/一回り/こじんまり/さかん/にこにこ/ひとえに

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、何気ない一言が、お祖父ちゃんを元気にしたわね
lines.en: Sho, you know — your little comment really brightened your grandfather up.
lines.style: Warm recognition, gentle cadence. Slight pause before 'your' as if savouring the moment. Soft, almost wondering tone — the pride of a mother noticing her child's kindness without making it heavy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが、あかね色の夕焼けを見てらしたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad was watching the sunset — that deep crimson one.
lines.style: Quiet observation, no rush. Small exhale before 'watching' — the memory settling in his voice. Even, factual delivery but with an underlying tenderness. A child noticing what matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは、たぐいまれな優しさをお持ちよ
lines.en: Your father has a gentleness that's quite rare, Sho.
lines.style: Reflective and measured. Slight wonder in the tone — not lecturing but sharing a small realisation. Warm but contemplative, as if speaking more to herself than to him, yet wanting him to hear it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、一回り大きくなったって、お祖父ちゃんに言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa said I've grown — that I'm bigger now.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Slight lift on 'bigger' — a child testing how the word feels, wanting confirmation. Earnest but not overplaying it. The softness of someone who believes it only because Grandpa said so.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家はこじんまりして、落ち着くわね
lines.en: You know, our home is small, but there's something so peaceful about it.
lines.style: Tender, almost settling into the words. Gentle pace. A slight smile in the voice without forcing it — the contentment of someone acknowledging home as a refuge, speaking more to the moment than demanding response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祭りがさかんな町に住みたいよ
lines.en: But Mom — I want to live in a town where there's always a festival happening.
lines.style: Eager pull forward on 'want'. Childhood wonder breaking through — not challenging her, just bright with longing. A pause before 'always' like he's imagining it. The rhythm of daydreaming aloud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが、にこにこしてらっしゃるわ
lines.style: Soft, delighted observation. Simple delivery with underlying warmth. A gentle pointing-out, inviting him to see what she sees. Quiet pleasure, almost conspiratorial in its gentleness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ひとえにメイ姉さんのおかげで絵を始めたよ
lines.en: Mom, I started drawing because of Mei-nee. All of it is because of her.
lines.style: Earnest, unguarded gratitude. Slight tremor of sincerity — he means this completely. Slow, intentional pace. A child naming something important without apology. Trailing softly at the end, like a confession of care.
